description: This file provides service functions for processing receipt documents, including file handling, OCR simulation, parsing, categorization, database interactions, and job management within an expense document management platform.

methods.name: ensure_dirs(path: str)
methods.description: Ensures the directory for a given path exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: str compute_checksum(file_path: str)
methods.description: Calculates the SHA256 checksum of a file located at the specified path.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] save_file(upload_dir: str, document_id: int, version_number: int, filename: str, file_stream)
methods.description: Saves an uploaded file to a structured directory path, returns storage path and checksum.

methods.name: str naive_ocr_text_from_file(file_path: str)
methods.description: Mocks OCR processing by returning a pseudo text including filename details.

methods.name: Dict parse_receipt(text: str)
methods.description: Extracts vendor, date, amount, and currency from OCR text using regex heuristics.

methods.name: upsert_extraction(document_id: int, parsed: Dict, raw_text: str)
methods.description: Creates or updates an Extraction record for a given document with parsed data.

methods.name: Tuple[str,float] auto_categorize(vendor: Optional[str], raw_text: Optional[str])
methods.description: Heuristically determines the category of a receipt based on vendor and raw text.

methods.name: assign_category(document_id: int, category_name: str, confidence: float = 0.8)
methods.description: Links a category to a document, creating category if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: log_action(action: str, document_id: Optional[int] = None, user_id: Optional[str] = None, details=None)
methods.description: Records an audit log entry for actions performed.

methods.name: Job create_job(job_type: str, document_id: Optional[int] = None, version_id: Optional[int] = None, meta=None)
methods.description: Creates a new processing job with specified type and related identifiers.

methods.name: run_job(job: Job, upload_dir: str)
methods.description: Executes a job synchronously, performing OCR or categorization depending on type.

ctags.name: assign_category
ctags.pattern: /^def assign_category(document_id: int, category_name: str, confidence: float = 0.8):$/

ctags.name: auto_categorize
ctags.pattern: /^def auto_categorize(vendor: Optional[str], raw_text: Optional[str]) -> Tuple[str, float]:$/

ctags.name: create_job
ctags.pattern: /^def create_job(job_type: str, document_id: Optional[int] = None, version_id: Optional[int] = Non/
ctags.signature: (job_type: str, document_id: Optional[int] = None, version_id: Optional[int] = None, meta=None)

ctags.name: log_action
ctags.pattern: /^def log_action(action: str, document_id: Optional[int] = None, user_id: Optional[str] = None, de/
ctags.signature: (action: str, document_id: Optional[int] = None, user_id: Optional[str] = None, details=None)

ctags.name: save_file
ctags.pattern: /^def save_file(upload_dir: str, document_id: int, version_number: int, filename: str, file_stream/
ctags.signature: (upload_dir: str, document_id: int, version_number: int, filename: str, file_stream)

ctags.name: upsert_extraction
ctags.pattern: /^def upsert_extraction(document_id: int, parsed: Dict, raw_text: str):$/
